property_summary: When cancelProposal(1,2) is called after creating a DAO-type proposal (proposal 1) that fails to store the proposed address due to the deleted assignment, the reference contract correctly stores the address (e.g., address(0x123)) while the buggy one stores address(0), causing mapPID_address(1) to differ.
change_summary: Delete the line that sets mapPID_address[proposalCount] = proposedAddress.
